named-query.name: findServerdirectoryByBasePath
named-query.query: select s from Serverdirectory s where s.basepath = :basepath

named-query.name: findSubscriptionactivityById
named-query.query: select s from Subscriptionactivity s where s.subscriptionid = :subscriptionid

named-query.name: findResourceById
named-query.query: select r from Resource r where r.id = :id

named-query.name: findAllCurrentResources
named-query.query: select r1 from Resource r1 where r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = r1.resourceid and r2.resourcetype = r1.resourcetype) and r1.status <> 'deleted'

named-query.name: findAllCurrentResourcesByType
named-query.query: select r1 from Resource r1 where r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = r1.resourceid and r2.resourcetype = :resourcetype) and r1.status <> 'deleted' and r1.resourcetype = :resourcetype

named-query.name: findAllTagsByResource
named-query.query: select rm1 from Resourcemetadata rm1 where rm1.resource.resourceid = (select r1.resourceid from Resource r1 where r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = :resourceid and r2.resourcetype = r1.resourcetype) and r1.status <> 'deleted') and rm1.paramtype = 'tag'

named-query.name: findAllGeneralTagsByResource
named-query.query: select rm1 from Resourcemetadata rm1 where rm1.resource.resourceid = (select r1.resourceid from Resource r1 where r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = :resourceid and r2.resourcetype = r1.resourcetype) and r1.status <> 'deleted') and rm1.paramtype = 'tag' and rm1.paramname = '_tag'

named-query.name: findAllProfileTagsByResource
named-query.query: select rm1 from Resourcemetadata rm1 where rm1.resource.resourceid = (select r1.resourceid from Resource r1 where r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = :resourceid and r2.resourcetype = r1.resourcetype) and r1.status <> 'deleted') and rm1.paramtype = 'tag' and rm1.paramname = '_profile'

named-query.name: findAllSecurityTagsByResource
named-query.query: select rm1 from Resourcemetadata rm1 where rm1.resource.resourceid = (select r1.resourceid from Resource r1 where r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = :resourceid and r2.resourcetype = r1.resourcetype) and r1.status <> 'deleted') and rm1.paramtype = 'tag' and rm1.paramname = '_security'

named-query.name: findParamByResource
named-query.query: select rm1 from Resourcemetadata rm1 where rm1.resource.resourceid = (select r1.resourceid from Resource r1 where r1.resourceid = :resourceid and r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = :resourceid and r2.resourcetype = :resourcetype) and r1.resourcetype = :resourcetype and r1.status <> 'deleted') and rm1.resource.resourcetype like :resourcetype and rm1.paramname = :paramname

named-query.name: findLevel1ParamByResource
named-query.query: select rm1 from Resourcemetadata rm1 where rm1.resource.resourceid = (select r1.resourceid from Resource r1 where r1.resourceid = :resourceid and r1.versionid = (select max(r2.versionid) from Resource r2 where r2.resourceid = :resourceid and r2.resourcetype = :resourcetype) and r1.resourcetype = :resourcetype and r1.status <> 'deleted') and rm1.resource.resourcetype like :resourcetype and rm1.paramname not like '%:%'
